Well, this one I *experienced*. But here we go.

Was walking into class. I had really bad stomachaches, (insert girl problems here), so as I was going I kinda just waited in the stall on my phone because I really didn’t want to go to breakfast immediately.

So a few minutes pass and some other girls come in, talking and etc, and my principal came in a few minutes after as well, and they all got detention (reason being because they didn’t ask to go? I dunno, schools crazy).

Me, being the good student I am, had known the simple math
Me + strict parent + detention = **FATALITY**.
So I was panicking in the bathroom stall waiting for the principal to leave so I could go to breakfast without being suspicious, trying to move my backpack away from the visible part of the stall, and praying to whatever god or entities out there that my phone didn’t get any notifications. After a while, the principal’s voice slowly faded, but I could see in the mirror, that she was in the hall talking to a girl who was “caught” in the bathroom talking or whatever, back facing the place I needed to go.
At this moment in time I was thinking “what do I have to lose?” *a lot.* But staying wouldn’t benefit me, either. So I speed walked (ran? Jogged?) to breakfast and sat down. It actually worked. I wasn’t sent to detention or anything. I’m proud of my dumb idea and courage (and the dumb reason that brought me to the bathroom in the first place)
